business_problem: Rafiqspace.ai needed a Bahasa Indonesia transcription platform accurate enough for parliamentary and regulated enterprise use, because manual transcription and generic speech tools were too slow, too inaccurate, and too expensive for same-day meeting records and live note-taking.
solution_summary: Rafiqspace.ai built a speech-intelligence platform on NVIDIA Nemotron technology so transcription, diarization, and government-grade document production could run in near real time. The company fine-tuned the Parakeet-CTC ASR model on H100 GPUs using proprietary parliamentary, business-meeting, lecture, and broadcast data, then deployed production inference on L40S GPUs for cost-efficient serving. This let the team tune specifically for Bahasa Indonesia vocabulary, multi-speaker environments, and sub-300-millisecond streaming demands that off-the-shelf services could not meet. The output integrates directly into meeting-minute workflows so parliamentary and regulated clients receive same-day records with speaker attribution instead of waiting days for manual processing. By pairing fine-tuning and low-cost inference in one stack, Rafiqspace turned speech AI into a viable compliance and records platform for Indonesia's public-sector and enterprise environments.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA Nemotron
solution_components.role: Provides the speech-model family Rafiqspace uses for fine-tuned Bahasa Indonesia transcription.

solution_components.name: Parakeet-CTC ASR model
solution_components.role: Serves as the base ASR model fine-tuned for Indonesian parliamentary and enterprise audio.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA H100 GPUs
solution_components.role: Handle fine-tuning and high-throughput batch transcription workloads.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA L40S GPUs
solution_components.role: Run cost-efficient production inference and streaming transcription.

data_flow: Meeting audio is streamed into the fine-tuned ASR stack, speaker-aware transcripts are generated on NVIDIA infrastructure, and the resulting text is inserted into government and enterprise minute-taking workflows for rapid review and distribution.
business_outcome: Rafiqspace reached 97.7% Bahasa Indonesia transcription accuracy, reduced transcription costs by up to 90%, cut manual effort by 95%, improved delivery from days to same-day records, and made live note-taking and speaker-attributed compliance documentation feasible for public-sector clients.
architecture_clues: Rafiqspace fine-tuned a speech model specifically for Bahasa Indonesia regulatory vocabulary and diarization.
H100 GPUs are used for tuning while L40S handles production serving economics.
The workflow is designed around official records and meeting-minute generation rather than general dictation.
evidence_quotes: By fine-tuning an open NVIDIA Nemotron speech, Parakeet ASR model on NVIDIA H100 and L40S GPUs, Rafiqspace.ai achieved 97.7% transcription accuracy
reducing per-hour transcription costs by up to 90%
cutting manual processing time from hours to minutes
same-day meeting minutes where turnaround previously took 2–3 days
